label: Google Analytics 4
purpose: Daily GA4 sessions, conversions, and revenue by session source and medium, so the tracker's counts can be reconciled with the client's own analytics.
data: One row per day, session source, and session medium from the GA4 property. GA4 counts sessions and attributes conversions its own way; the shares between the two systems are the reading, not the levels.

sessions.label: GA4 sessions
sessions.data: GA4 sessions summed over the period's days.

engaged_sessions.label: GA4 engaged sessions
engaged_sessions.data: GA4 engaged sessions summed over the period's days.

conversions.label: GA4 conversions
conversions.data: GA4 key events summed over the period's days.

purchase_revenue.label: GA4 purchase revenue
purchase_revenue.data: GA4 purchase revenue summed over the period's days.
